note: On the Red Deer River 13 km east of Drumheller (5075 Hwy 10) in the Badlands, with river access; the river-side row is screened from the water by a belt of shrubs and trees. Lots about 40-45 ft wide and 50+ ft deep. Seasonal lots fill much of the park (site map). Water is shut off October 19 and the last night of camping is October 31 (2026); trailer rentals and tent sites too. --Claude
summary: Operator pages read: base now C$30 (no-hookup RV site; was 50), high C$50 power+water, GST extra, rate covers 4 people (8 max); 30-amp + water, coin laundry, 2 dumps; online booking via Checkfront. Passes the price gate (C$30) and presence (website + phone, Google 4.3/480). Riverview kept.

LONG-STAY TESTS: the site map legend shows PW nightly sites 1-12, 51-74, 110-120 and seasonal PW 13-50, 75-109 plus PWS seasonal S14-S43 (~103 seasonal vs ~87 nightly RV sites per the Checkfront API, ~45% nightly).
